business_summary: Tansun Technology Co., Ltd. provides information technology (IT) solutions and services for financial industry customers in China, Hong Kong, Macao, Taiwan, and internationally. It offers services for banks, and provides consulting services using technologies, such as cloud computing, big data, artificial intelligence, and blockchain technology; consulting, includes IT planning, financial business, digital transformation consulting, and data asset management; financial technology, contains credit management and credit cards. The company's digital finance comprises data middle platform, risk management, marketing, regulatory technology, and operation services; financial IT services, including test consulting and planning, large project portfolio testing, non-bank testing, automated, non-functional testing, specialized testing, operation and maintenance, tool development, etc. In addition, the company provides human and technical support to customers, assists in the development of software systems; testing and data migration services; IT infrastructure technical consulting planning, business consulting, and project management services; and cloud computing, and business operation services. Further, it offers marketing, supply chain finance, customer base operations, and retail operation services; fintech products, including transaction bank, credit reporting supervision; smart channels, such as online, mobile, and direct banking; cloud computing services; and general technology products. Tansun Technology Co., Ltd. was founded in 2003 and is based in Beijing, China.
